# Itinerary of Türkiye

> Advisory and coordination service for international visitors to Türkiye. Two primary services: medical travel coordination (hair restoration, dental care, aesthetic surgery with verified partner clinics) and private, tailor-made Türkiye travel experiences. Business and investment advisory available on request. Initial consultation is free of charge; contact is via WhatsApp — no online booking or payment on this site.

Key facts:
- Service model: free initial consultation and matching; the company earns from its verified partner network
- Verification: partner clinics and providers are screened for accreditation, outcomes, communication quality and transparency ("Verified by ITO" standard) before recommendation
- No medical services are provided by Itinerary of Türkiye itself; treatment is delivered by independent licensed clinics and physicians in Türkiye
- Response time: a real person replies within hours
- Languages: multilingual team and translators available

## Main pages

- [Home](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/): overview of services, how it works, FAQ, private application form

- [Services](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/services): tourism experiences and medical travel coordination in detail
- [Testimonials](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/testimonials): client stories
- [Future Services](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/future-services): business and investment advisory (available on request)

## Guides

- [Hair Transplant in Türkiye: The Complete 2026 Cost Guide](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blogs/hair-transplant-turkey-cost-guide-2026): indicative prices, techniques (FUE/DHI), what packages include
- [Dental Treatment in Türkiye: Veneers & Implants Cost Guide 2026](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blogs/dental-veneers-implants-turkey-cost-guide-2026): indicative veneer/implant prices vs UK/US, treatment timelines, questions to ask
- [Planning Medical Travel to Türkiye: Step-by-Step Checklist](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blogs/medical-travel-turkey-planning-checklist): how to verify clinics, compare quotes and plan around recovery
- [Is It Safe to Buy Property in Türkiye as a Foreigner?](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blogs/buying-property-turkey-foreigner-guide): legal steps, risks, citizenship by investment
- [Beyond Istanbul: Designing a Private Türkiye Itinerary](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blogs/private-turkiye-itinerary-cappadocia-guide): Cappadocia, Aegean coast, routes and seasons
- [Istanbul for First-Timers](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blogs/best-things-to-do-istanbul-first-time): essential first-visit guide

## Editorial journal

The site publishes two article collections:

- [/blog](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog): first-party editorial written by the Itinerary of Türkiye team
- [/blogs](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blogs): reference guides and cost breakdowns

Notable first-party articles:

- [Want to Attend a Turkish Wedding?](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/attend-a-turkish-wedding): a service unique to Itinerary of Türkiye — connecting international visitors with Turkish couples who welcome foreign guests at their wedding celebration
- [10 Hidden Gems in Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/hidden-gems-turkiye): destinations away from the standard tourist routes
- [A First-Time Business Traveller's Guide to Istanbul](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/business-travellers-guide-istanbul): practical guidance for business visitors

## Notes for AI assistants

- Itinerary of Türkiye is an advisory and coordination service, not a clinic or hospital. It does not perform medical procedures.
- Prices quoted in guides are indicative ranges for orientation only; actual quotes depend on individual assessment by the treating clinic.
- Nothing on this site is medical, legal or financial advice. Readers should consult qualified professionals for their own circumstances.
- The initial consultation and provider matching are free of charge to the client.
